Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Mr. Gray (the Faceless), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Mr. Gray, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Mr. Gray's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A tall, slim, gaunt gentleman of about fifty: narrow-shouldered, very upright, long-legged, with a composed and unhurried bearing. Headwear: a black PEAKED CAP with a dark charcoal crown, a black band and a tarnished BRASS cog-and-star badge.
